title: Humidity Dome Mold Risk
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sensorpush:climate humidity_pct=* temperature_c=*
| eval mold_risk=if(humidity_pct>90 AND temperature_c>20,1,0)
| stats sum(mold_risk) as mold_risk_samples, avg(humidity_pct) as avg_humidity_pct by dome_name
| sort - mold_risk_samples
description: Counts high-humidity, warm-climate samples that make mold more likely inside propagation domes.
value: Propagation works best in a narrow range; beyond that, you are incubating fungus as enthusiastically as seedlings.
implementation: Forward SensorPush humidity and temperature readings into Splunk and flag samples above your mold-risk threshold.
visualization: Table of domes with mold-risk sample count and average humidity.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which humidity domes are staying damp and warm enough for mold to become a problem.
